title: Keggin-Type Tridecanuclear Europium-Oxo Nanocluster Protected by Silsesquioxanes

synthesis.procedure: A fresh (Ph4Si4O8)4− ligand solution was first prepared by stirring PhSi(OMe)3 (2.2 mmol, 5.29 g) in 50 mL ethanol for 30 min at ambient temperature, adding NaOH (1 g, 0.025 mol), and refluxing for 2 h; the white turbid solution was cooled and used as prepared. For Eu13, Eu(NO3)3·6H2O (0.0892 g, 0.2 mmol) and 2,2′-bipyridine (0.0156 g, 0.1 mmol) were dissolved in 5 mL DMF/MeCN (v/v = 2/3), 30 μL Et3N was added, and the mixture was sonicated for 15 min (25 °C, 160 W). Fresh (Ph4Si4O8)4− solution (1 mL) was added and the mixture was sonicated for another 5 min, then transferred to a 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave and heated at 100 °C for 2000 min. After slow cooling, filtration, and room-temperature evaporation, colorless block crystals of Eu13 formed in about 4 days (yield ca. 45% based on Eu(NO3)3·6H2O). 2,2′-Bipyridine is not present in the final structure but is required for a useful yield. No inert atmosphere is required.
synthesis.temperature: ligand reflux 2 h; sonication 25 °C; solvothermal 100 °C; crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: ligand: 30 min stir then 2 h reflux; sonication 15 min then 5 min; autoclave 2000 min; crystals in about 4 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ultrasonication then 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave (solvothermal)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling, the mixture was filtered and the clear filtrate was left to evaporate at room temperature; colorless block crystals of Eu13 formed in about 4 days.

properties.summary: Eu13 shows intense solid-state Eu(III) red luminescence under UV and visible excitation (395, 466, and 535 nm), with 5D0 lifetime 884 μs at 293 K (907 μs at 83 K), estimated quantum yield 50%, CIE (0.66, 0.34), optical band gap 3.20 eV, and temperature-dependent emission intensity useful as a luminescent thermometer. Powder remains luminescent for more than 2 years. Crystal color alone is not used as an optical measurement.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Keggin-type tridecanuclear europium-oxo silsesquioxane nanocluster (DEF analogue of Eu13)

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same solvothermal procedure as Eu13, except that DMF was replaced by N,N-diethylformamide (DEF). After analogous cooling, filtration, and crystallization, Eu13-2 was obtained in about 46% yield based on Eu(NO3)3·6H2O.

reagents.amount: replaces DMF in the Eu13 solvent mixture

solvents: DEF/MeCN (DEF replacing DMF in the Eu13 DMF/MeCN v/v = 2/3 mixture)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: same as Eu13: sonication then 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Same workup as Eu13 (filtration and standing evaporation after cooling).

properties.summary: Main-text photophysical and photoelectric measurements are reported for Eu13; no separate magnetic or optical data are given for Eu13-2.
